question: Who is this user: profile, role, licence, active or frozen, permission sets and licences?

steps.name: user
steps.soql: SELECT Id, Username, Name, IsActive, UserType, Profile.Name, UserRole.Name, Profile.UserLicense.Name, LastLoginDate, CreatedDate FROM User WHERE Username = '{user}'

steps.name: frozen
steps.soql: SELECT UserId, IsFrozen FROM UserLogin WHERE UserId IN ({@user.Id})

steps.name: assignments
steps.soql: SELECT PermissionSet.Name, PermissionSet.Label, PermissionSetGroup.DeveloperName, ExpirationDate FROM PermissionSetAssignment WHERE Assignee.Username = '{user}' AND PermissionSet.IsOwnedByProfile = false ORDER BY PermissionSet.Name

steps.name: licences
steps.soql: SELECT PermissionSetLicense.DeveloperName, PermissionSetLicense.MasterLabel FROM PermissionSetLicenseAssign WHERE Assignee.Username = '{user}' ORDER BY PermissionSetLicense.DeveloperName

verdicts.say: No user {user} on this org. Sandbox usernames carry a suffix.

traps: A sandbox refresh rewrites usernames, so the same person has a different username per org.
